Extreme Tracks VR: Racing Game

Experience the thrill of high-speed VR racing like never before.
Extreme Tracks VR puts you inside the driver’s seat of powerful racing cars and challenges you to conquer some of the most intense tracks ever designed for virtual reality.

Race through multiple environments including desert highways, futuristic cities, mountain roads, and sharp turn  F1 tracks. Every track is designed to test your driving skills, reflexes, and control.

Feel the adrenaline as you drift around sharp corners, speed down long highways, and perform extreme racing maneuvers in fully immersive VR.

Whether you love car racing games, driving simulators, or extreme racing challenges, Extreme Tracks VR delivers an exciting experience built specifically for VR players.

Features

🏎 Multiple Extreme Tracks
Race through diverse environments including city roads, deserts, mountains, and stunt arenas.

🚗 Immersive VR Driving
Feel like you are truly inside the car with realistic VR racing mechanics.

🌍 Different Environments
Explore unique racing worlds with different track challenges.

⚡ High Speed Racing Action
Push your car to the limit and test your racing skills.

🎮 Designed for VR
Built specifically for immersive VR gameplay.
